description: Derives the prima via premise that a thing moves only insofar as it is in act. Case split on whether the mover y is the moved x. If distinct: y causes x's being r (OPEN bridge), so y is more r than x (Metaphysics II.1), so y has r in act (quarta via). If y = x: y moves itself by a distinct part p (OPEN reading of Physics VIII.4-5); by the distinct case p is in act in r, and the whole is in act through its part (OPEN). It does not use STMT-NO-MOVER-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-ITS-RESPECT, which is derived from the conclusion. This answers the self-mover gap that rejected the lead in ATTEMPT-REJECTED-DERIVATION-LEADS-20261107.
